# Golden Lady

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The Golden Lady is distinguished by her long golden hair, which reaches all the way down to her feet. She wears a dress that glitters and glistens, resembling living gold.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Personality

The Golden Lady spends her time continuously playing a golden harp. Her music can be heard along the shore by attentive listeners, though it is frequently mistaken for the sound of the wind blowing through the rocks.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

_Not yet known._

## Abilities

- plays on a golden harp all day long  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

The Golden Lady is an imaginative shore friend created by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's pupil, [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She features in Paul's inventive correspondence detailing fantastical adventures, including sailing into a moonglade and traveling to the sunset. [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) ultimately clarifies that his letters and adventures regarding her are entirely fictional.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P10](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0010), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P14](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0014), +16 more_
